claim_text: Under Assumptions 1 and 2, conditional on exact subspace recovery and for t<=N^{O(1)}, Theorem 1 bounds expected L2 score error by C_score d M^3/N [1/t + sigma^(k vee 2)/t^((k vee 2)/2+1)] polylog(N), with C_score independent of N,d,M,t.
domain: Every target satisfying Assumptions 1 and 2, conditional on the theorem's exact-recovery event
verification_criterion: Pin and extract the exact statement; independently prove that the known ambient normal score cancels, verify the k-dimensional analytic factor and every d/k dependency transition, and reject ambient substitution.
non_circularity: No sample size, time, tolerance, or slope is selected from the theorem formula.
scope_limit: The certificate does not remove the theorem's exact-recovery condition or repair Appendix B.1 Lemma 3.
